values.note: First-come, first-served only: arrive, claim a site and pay with recreation.gov Scan and Pay (download the app first; cell service is limited).

note: USFS (Custer Gallatin NF) campground on Hebgen Lake, 8 mi W of West Yellowstone on US-20 then 6 mi N on Hebgen Lake Rd (FR 167); concession-run by ExplorUS. A 35-ft turnaround limit. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed 9 FCFS scan-and-pay sites, $23 (2026; FS also shows a stale $16), not reservable. Changed potable_water true -> false (FS: 'Potable water is not available'); added showers false, dump false, max_rig_ft 70 (site 9 driveway; 25-70 ft listed). Vault toilets left (FS amenity says 'No restroom available' but its site descriptions mention restrooms; flagged). Season not written: FS says 'May - September, weather dependent' and also that off-season camping is free with no amenities. Operator ExplorUS (concessionaire), FCFS. The Lonesomewood prescribed-fire closure (north of Hebgen Lake) ended Oct 18, 2026 and did not list FR 167. Note: drinking water removed, restated values trimmed.
